heroPrompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: Home banner illustration for a Chinese learning mini program named Xinbotu, no written words in the illustration.
Primary request: A beautiful open ivory book becoming a winding learning path, a small forest-green compass, three floating paper pages and soft translucent geometric arches. Communicate curiosity, learning and an inviting journey.
Style: premium restrained 3D clay illustration, rounded porcelain surfaces, soft ambient occlusion, subtle glass details. Calm warm daylight, refined editorial composition, no busy details.
Palette: forest green #143f32, sage green, ivory, light gray #f8f8f9, tiny muted warm gold highlights.
Composition: landscape, subject slightly right of center, balanced generous breathing room, all objects within central 70 percent, background uniform very light gray. Objects should be clear at mobile banner size.
Constraints: no people, no letters, no text, no logo, no watermark, no UI mockup, no gradient banding.
appIconPrompt: Use case: logo-brand. Create a fresh innovative app icon for Xinbotu, a Chinese knowledge and learning app. Exactly one bold memorable symbol, not a UI screenshot. Square 1024 canvas, full-bleed background extending to all four edges, no pre-rounded corners. Main symbol occupies 65 to 72 percent of the square with balanced margin. Strong contrast, thick simple shapes, readable at 24px. No text, letters, numbers, watermarks, badges, device mockups, graduation caps or lightbulbs. Make the symbol distinctive and beautifully proportioned, with no tiny ornaments. Concept: UPWARD ROUTE. A clever completely flat graphic emblem in near-black ink: one compact rounded square labyrinth whose generous negative-space path makes exactly three ascending steps and opens toward the upper-right. Integrate route and progress into one unique symbol. Golden amber #FFBF37 full-bleed background with pure charcoal #202025 mark. Swiss graphic design clarity, perfectly flat vector-like solid fills, no gradient or bevel, no shadow. Large negative spaces and rounded inner corners, refined high-impact logomark. No book, no circle orbit, no bird, no frame around the icon.
previousAppIconPrompt:
Use case: logo-brand
Asset type: App icon for a Chinese educational mini program named Xinbotu, no lettering in the icon.
Primary request: A memorable, elegant app icon: one ivory open book whose center fold transforms into a simple gently ascending path pointing forward and upward. Integrate the book and path into a single bold recognizable symbol. Learning, knowledge and an open journey.
Style: contemporary minimal premium app icon, clean sculptural ivory porcelain symbol with very subtle raised depth, precise balanced silhouette, smooth edges, restrained soft lighting. Much simpler and bolder than an illustration. No small decorative objects.
Palette: solid deep forest green #143f32 background, warm ivory symbol, a subtle sage highlight only if useful. No gold, no blue, no rainbow.
Composition: perfectly square canvas; full-bleed green background extends to all four edges and corners, do not bake rounded corners into the image. Centered symbol occupies about 68 percent of the canvas. Strong contrast and large strokes, recognizable at 24 pixels. Balanced padding on all sides.
Constraints: no text, no letters, no numbers, no slogan, no watermark, no mockup, no device frame, no border, no extra ornaments, no mountain scene, no abstract tangled shapes. One simple iconic mark only.
